## SDK change

Describe the SDK, documentation or first-party example fix and its checks. Third-party customization packs are shared independently, not submitted to this repository.

## Rights and validation

- [ ] I have the right to submit the included material under its applicable terms.

- [ ] I identified third-party material and ran the relevant validation without executing untrusted plugin code.
